## Pre-registered effects (arm full)

1. Maximum block span >= 20: 51.3 -> **holds**.
2. First session with span >= 80 in [250, 865]: per seed [None, None, None] -> **fails, never**; span at 865 42.2 [41.6-43.2] (DD 104).
3. 4-digit error > 3-digit error (250-865): 0.105 vs 0.072 -> **holds** (EPAM 3.0% vs 1.5%).
4. Prior speeds early learning (span s50 full vs prioroff): 10.9 vs 8.6 -> **holds**.
5. Letter probe final <= 9 at every probe: max 11 -> **fails**.
- prefixoff: span s865 full vs prefixoff per seed [('41.7', '16.3'), ('41.6', '15.7'), ('43.2', '15.6')] -> full beats it on every seed: **True**.
- patternoff: span s865 full vs patternoff per seed [('41.7', '42.4'), ('41.6', '39.1'), ('43.2', '50.1')] -> full beats it on every seed: **False**.
- conceptsoff: span s865 full vs conceptsoff per seed [('41.7', '34.5'), ('41.6', '31.7'), ('43.2', '33.1')] -> full beats it on every seed: **True**.
